questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of relations (integrations) in Juju?
options: To allow charms to automatically discover connection data, credentials, and configuration between services
To merge multiple source code repositories into a single Git branch
To encrypt physical network cables between data center racks
To bundle multiple OS images into a single ISO
questions.answer: To allow charms to automatically discover connection data, credentials, and configuration between services
questions.explanation: Relations establish communication channels where charms share credentials, endpoints, and status dynamically.

questions.prompt: Which endpoint role is used for communication between units of the same application (e.g. cluster clustering/replication)?
questions.explanation: 'peers' endpoints allow units of the same application to discover each other and form clusters.

questions.prompt: What allows two distinct charms to be integrated together?
options: They must implement compatible relation interfaces
They must be installed in the same Linux directory
They must be written in the same programming language
They must use the same application name
questions.answer: They must implement compatible relation interfaces
questions.explanation: Relations require compatible interface definitions (e.g. pgsql, mysql, ingress) defined in their metadata.
